[LFST.2.3] **Deterministic on-disk equality is an
integrator-side property of the chosen encoding.**
Two integrators using the same encoding on the same
platform produce byte-identical files; two
integrators using different encodings of the same
event sequence produce different bytes that
nevertheless round-trip to the same typed events.
The conformance check is the round-trip property,
not byte equality across pipelines.
